market_morning.title: Ka Mynstep ha Iew
market_morning.text: I Mary i la leit iew dang step. I la thied lai tylli ki soh apple saw bad uwei u ruti. Ka sngi ka tyngshaiñ bha haba i wan phai sha iing.
market_morning.q1: Shano i Mary i leit mynstep?
market_morning.q2: Katno tylli ki soh apple i la thied?

dog_walk.title: Leit pyniaid ia u Ksew
dog_walk.text: U John u la ialam ia u ksew jong u, u Max, ban leit pyniaid kai ha phark. U Max u la beh ia ka thapbalieh stem hajan u dieng bah. Ki la sah hangta haduh ban da sep sngi.
dog_walk.q2: Ia aiu u ksew u la beh?

making_tea.title: Shet Sha
making_tea.text: Ka Sarah ka la buh ia u ketli ha chula ban shet sha. Ka la jied ia ka sha peppermint namar ka dei ba ka bang tam. Ka la dih sngewbha ia ka bad iwei i biskit rit.
making_tea.q1: Kaei ka jaid sha ba ka Sarah ka la jied?
making_tea.q2: Aiu ka la bam bad ka sha?

festival_day.title: Ka Sngi Lehkmen
festival_day.text: Ka shnong ka la pynitynnad da ki bti phyrnai na bynta ka lehkmen man u snem. Ki khynnah ki la phong ki jain tynrai bad shad ha pdeng shnong. Baroh ki la jasam ia ki kpu thiang bad lehkmen lang.
festival_day.q1: Kumno la pynitynnad ia ka shnong?
festival_day.q2: Shano ki khynnah ki la shad?
festival_day.q3: Kaei ka jingbam ba baroh ki la sam lang?

lost_keys.title: Ki Chabi ba Jah
lost_keys.text: U David um shym la shem ia ki chabi kali jong u. U la wad ha miej shet ja, ha miej paki shnong, bad khatduh u la shem ia ki hapoh ka pla sopti coat. U la sngewluid bad la kyrkieh sha ka jingiakynduh jong u.
lost_keys.q1: Haei u David u la shem khatduh ia ki chabi?
lost_keys.q2: Kumno u la sngew haba u la shem ia ki?

visiting_friend.title: Leit jngoh paralok barim
visiting_friend.text: Sngi u Blei ba la lah, ka Helen ka la leit da ka rel ban leit jngoh ia ka paralok naduh khynnah, ka Alice. Kim shym la iakynduh la san snem. Ki la pynlut baroh shi sngi ban peit ia ki dur barim bad dih coffee.
visiting_friend.q1: Kumno ka Helen ka la leit?
visiting_friend.q2: La katno snem ba kim shym la iakynduh?

childhood_home.title: Phai sha ka Iing Mynkhynnah
childhood_home.text: Hadien sawphew snem, u Robert u la rai ban leit jngoh ia ka iing rit ha kaba u la heh. U dieng sohphan heh ha khmat iing u dang don, hynrei ka kynroh dieng barim la pynkylla da ka kynroh maw. U la ieng harud ka khyrdop, u da kynmaw ia ki sngi lyiur ba u la pynlut da kaba ialehkai bad u hynmen jong u.
childhood_home.q1: La katno snem ba u Robert um shym la leit jngoh ia ka iing mynkhynnah jong u?
childhood_home.q2: U dieng aiu u ba don ha khmat iing?
childhood_home.q3: Da aiu la pynkylla ia ka kynroh dieng barim?
childhood_home.q4: Bad uei u Robert u la kynmaw ba u ialehkai?

long_journey.title: Ka Jingleit ba Jrong
long_journey.text: Ka jingleit rel na ka shnong rud duriaw sha ki lum ka la shim por khatar kynta. Ka Maria ka la pule lai lynnong na ka kot khana jong ka bad ka la peit ia ka mariang ba kylla na ki madan jyrngam sha ki kliar lum tap ior. Ka la poi ha steshon hamar ba dang sep ka sngi, kaba la kloi na bynta ka chuti tlang jong ka.
long_journey.q1: Katno ka jingleit rel ka la shim por?
long_journey.q2: Kaei ka Maria ka la leh ha ka jingleit?
long_journey.q2_c1: Pule lai lynnong na ka kot
long_journey.q2_c2: Kren bad kiwei ki nongleit jingleit
long_journey.q3: Sha aiu ka mariang ka la kylla?
long_journey.q4: Lano ka la poi ha steshon?

special_recipe.title: Ka Rukom Shet ba Kynsai
special_recipe.text: Meirad ka ju pynkhreh ia ka syrwa syiar ba kynsai man ba don uba pang ha iing. U jingthep ba buhrieh jong ka u dei u sying dang khuid bad ka um sohjew. Ka shim por lai kynta ban shet bha, kaba pynbih bha ia ka iing baroh kawei.
special_recipe.q1: Lano meirad ka ju pynkhreh ia ka syrwa ba kynsai?
special_recipe.q3: Katno por ka shim ban shet ia ka syrwa?
special_recipe.q4: Kaei ka jingbih ba ka la pyndap ia ka iing?
